newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Caja Madrid launches 80 bln pta 10-yr bond.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Caja Madrid launches 80 bln pta 10-yr bond.

text.p: Spain's Caja de Madrid savings bank said it is launching a domestic 10-year bond of 80 billion pesetas, with a 5.75 percent yearly yield.

The note said the denomination will be of 100,000 pesetas. The bond will be convertible to euro at the legal exchange rate fixed for Spanish entry into Europe's single currency. Coupons are paid on a quarterly basis.

Caja Madrid said the issue could be increased up to 100 billion pesetas. The bond will be offered from April 28 to May 28. Caja de Madrid is rated AA2 by Moody's and AA- by Standard and Poor's, the note added.
